_doc: Time-boxed dependency audit exceptions (NEXA-M1-009 gate, NEXA-GOV-001). Each entry covers exact advisory ids for one exact package version and expires. v1/tools/audit_gate.py fails CI on any advisory not listed here, on an expired entry, and on an entry whose version is no longer pinned.

exceptions.approved_by: NEXA project owner (decision recorded 2026-11-02, M2 knowledge work)
exceptions.reason: Pillow 13.0.0 fixes these advisories but requires Python 3.11+; the v1 runtime and the DGX venv are Python 3.10. Python 3.10 reached end of life in October 2026.
exceptions.mitigation: Untrusted images never reach Pillow decoders: direct PNG/JPEG/TIFF uploads are refused on Pillow below 13 (NEXA_KNOWLEDGE_IMAGE_UPLOADS=auto); PDF pages are rendered by pdfium into raw bitmaps; DOCX/PPTX images are not decoded. Pillow only handles bitmaps the service renders itself. NEXA never encodes TIFF with Pillow (CVE-2026-112902 / PYSEC-2026-4363 is in the libtiff TIFF encoder): the service writes no images, and the only Pillow encoding is in offline tools (JPEG/PDF from repository files). CVE-2026-128066 (memory exhaustion while parsing TIFF/EXIF metadata on open) needs an untrusted image opened by Pillow, which the upload gate above prevents. CVE-2026-128067 is in the libtiff TIFF encoder, which NEXA never uses.
exceptions.exit: Move the v1 runtime to Python 3.12, pin Pillow 13+, delete this entry.
